newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leans toward majority in Feb barley vote.
newsitem.headline: Canada leans toward majority in Feb barley vote.

text.p: Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said on Friday he was leaning toward accepting a simple majority in a referendum on whether to keep the Canadian Wheat Board's monopoly over barley trade.
He also said in remarks to reporters that he aimed to hold the vote in February.
Asked if he would accept a result of 50 percent plus one vote, Goodale said: "That's my fundamental direction."
But he raised the question of what to do if voter participation were low and the results were tight on the ballot, which he said would be conducted by mail.
"If there were a very close result and a very low turnout, then there may be those who could advance an argument that that really isn't a clear-cut result," he said.
